subject: Re: DPA / data mapping & evidence request — Acme Health
messages:
From: Samir Chopra <samir.chopra@acmehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: DPA / data mapping & evidence request

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood last week. Security has a couple of follow-ups before we can complete our vendor review: a) a detailed data map showing where PII is stored/transferred, b) confirmation of key management and rotation for customer keys, and c) a list of subprocessors (storage, monitoring, analytics) with country locations for cross-border review.

Can you:
- Attach a diagram of the request/response data flow (tokenization, logs, backups)
- Provide a short note on whether any raw customer PII is stored on persistent volumes and for how long by default
- Share KMS rotation evidence or a snapshot showing last rotation dates (or a pointer to where we can validate)

We need this by EOD Tuesday (11/30) to make our SLA/contracting timeline. Appreciate it —

Samir Chopra
Security Engineer — Acme Health
security@acmehealth.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Samir Chopra <samir.chopra@acmehealth.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: DPA / data mapping & evidence request

Samir —

Thanks for the clear list. We're preparing a short evidence bundle and a simplified data mapping diagram. High-level answers up front:
- Persistent storage: Redwood does not persist raw customer PII by default. User inputs and model outputs pass through the inference runtime; we retain request metadata for 30 days for billing/observability unless a customer opts in to longer retention.
- KMS & rotation: Customers can bring keys (BYOK) via our KMS integration or use Redwood-managed keys. Attached is a snapshot of the last rotation events for the managed KMS and a note describing BYOK flow.
- Subprocessors: Attached CSV lists subprocessors and regions. Key ones: GigaCloud Storage (us-east-1), TelemetryWorks (monitoring, eu-west-1), FastLogs (backup, us-east-2). All subprocessors are contractually bound for data handling and cross-border transfer safeguards.

I'm attaching: redwood_dpa_v3.pdf, piI-data-mapping-20261129.png, kms-rotation-log-20261129.txt, subprocessor-list-20261129.csv. If you need a diagram in a different format or a more detailed field-level mapping, we can follow up tomorrow.

Next steps: Marcus (security lead) is looping in with a short attestation; Monica from Legal will confirm the DPA redline timeline.

Best,
Rachel
Director, Customer Security — Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -05:00
Subject: Internal: Acme Health evidence and attestation

Rachel / Monica —

Saw Samir's request and Rachel's bundle. Quick notes from infra/security:
- The diagram shows flow correctly; callout: ephemeral KV cache exists on-GPU and is zeroed on model shutdown — no persistent copy.
- Backups: FastLogs takes encrypted snapshots; backups are encrypted client-side in transit and at rest; backup retention is configurable per customer (default 90 days for logs; backups for recovery are 30 days).
- KMS rotation log: managed keys rotate every 90 days; attached log shows last rotation 2026-08-02 and 2026-11-01 for two regional key rings.
- Cross-border: when region is explicitly pinned (e.g., us-east-1), no data leaves that region except operational metadata (short IP/latency markers) — we can provide a conditional clause in the DPA.

Action items: Monica — can Legal confirm if the proposed conditional clause for region pinning is acceptable and whether we can include the subprocessor addendum (standard for health customers)? Also Rachel — will you provide the field-level mapping (CSV) for the sample requests they shared?

Marcus
Head of Platform Security — Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Acme Health evidence and attestation

Marcus / Rachel —

We can accept a region-pinning rider in the DPA for Acme Health with the following constraints: 1) they must select a supported region at onboarding, 2) we include a limited operational transfer exception for troubleshooting (logged & audited), and 3) subprocessors list must be kept current with 30 days' notice for changes. I'll produce a short redline and the addendum language today and send to Samir.

I also requested the field-level CSV from Product — Rachel, if you can attach that CSV we can close the mapping ask.

Monica Patel
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the patience. Attached is a short field-level CSV mapping for the sample endpoints you provided (pii-field-mapping-acme-20261130.csv) and a formal redline for a region-pinning rider from Legal. Highlights:
- No raw PII is persisted by default; derived outputs and metadata follow retention windows described in the DPA (30 days telemetry, 30 days logs, 90 days backups for recovery unless configured).
- Subprocessors: GigaCloud Storage (us-east-1) — object storage for transient artifacts; TelemetryWorks (eu-west-1) — monitoring/metrics; FastLogs (us-east-2) — encrypted backups. Full contractual commitments and SCCs (where applicable) are included in the dpa PDF.
- KMS: BYOK path documented; managed-key rotation events attached (kms-rotation-log-20261129.txt). For Acme Health we recommend BYOK if you need exclusive control — we can walk through BYOK onboarding next week.

Links & attachments:
- Evidence bundle (attachments in this thread)
- Field map: https://drive.google.com/file/d/pii-field-mapping-acme-20261130.csv
- Docusign: https://na.docusign.com/packaging/DocuSign-ACME-DPA-77 (for redline acceptance)

If this looks good, can we confirm the region pinning option and target the DPA signature by end of next week? Happy to schedule a 30-minute call with Marcus to walk through the KMS/BYOK flow.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Director, Customer Security — Redwood Inference
